title: Stripe moves to 23.1.0 and the API version pin moves to 2026-10-28.endive as a deliberate decision

source.ref: #4486 test job 2026-11-02: the minor-and-patch bump took stripe to 23.1.0 and stripe-api-version.test.ts failed on the pin

detail: stripe 23.1.0 bakes in API version 2026-10-28.endive; the pin was 2026-09-30.endive and stripe-api-version.test.ts makes a drift a decision. Stripe's changelog says every Endive version after 2026-09-30 is additive only, and the repo's calls were already moved to the Endive shapes (payment_method_types removal) at the first Endive version, so nothing a call sends or reads changes. Owner chose to take it now (2026-11-02). Retest: lib/billing, app/api/stripe and app/api/webhooks vitest sets, 888 tests, green. No real-card run (owner declined manual payment tests). The probe holds the pin and the installed SDK at 2026-10-28.endive. Fixed 2026-11-02.
